title: Test global-loss gating for adaptive connectome credit
description: S17 tests whether exact first-order global loss evidence should gate candidate confirmations in the continuously learning adaptive connectome. Compare S16 vector-credit morphology against an otherwise identical --structural-global-fitness arm on seeds 7, 13, and 21 without freezing body learning or exploratory traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Run matched 2000-update 4090 trials for all three seeds; preserve identical initialization and traffic except the global-fitness gate; report complete held-out BPC curves, terminal paired ordering/noise, structural events and active fan-in; generate a graph that makes the stopping horizon and any full-fan-in gap visible; promote the gate only if replicated evidence supports it.
notes: Completed three matched 2000-update 4090 runs. Global-loss gating beats S16 adaptive at 11/15 terminal seed measurements and all 3 endpoints. Seed7 independently supports it (5/5, mean 0.0738 BPC, 4.10x noise); seed13 is terminally tied (2/5, mean 0.0005); seed21 is directionally positive (4/5, mean 0.0248). The three-seed mean wins 5/5 terminal checkpoints, mean 0.0331 BPC, effect/noise 2.71x. Active edges 36/31/30. Retain as working policy, not UI promotion; fixed-full still has 0.1181 mean endpoint BPC headroom. Graph: s17-global-fitness-decision.html.
close_reason: Ran the predeclared three-seed horizon with complete curves and anatomy telemetry. The global-loss gate produced a modest pooled capability gain and is retained for the next backward-credit experiment.

title: Diagnose RTX 2070S Xid 69 under sustained CUDA load
description: After reboot restored both GPUs, an isolated sustained FP16 PyTorch soak on the RTX 2070 Super failed after 32 seconds with cudaErrorLaunchFailure and kernel Xid 69 class error at PCI 04:00.0. Fresh small CUDA contexts still pass on both GPUs and the 4090 was idle/unaffected. Establish whether the fault is workload-specific, driver/GSP, PCIe/power, or hardware; do not run it concurrently with valuable 4090 jobs until an isolated SOL-native checkpointed workload passes.
notes:
Synthetic 8192x8192 FP16 soak failed after 32s with cuda launch failure and kernel Xid69. Driver remained usable; fresh small contexts passed on both cards. Exact SOL-native seed13 workload then completed 1,000 isolated updates/four evals in 9m58s at ~60W without fault and resumed to 5,000. Concurrent 4090 inference sweep plus subsequent S11 training began without new Xid. Continue monitoring; synthetic failure may be kernel-specific, but checkpoint protection remains mandatory.
Exact SOL-native seed13 run completed all 5,000 updates over 40m28s on the 2070S, followed immediately by a fresh S6 workload. No new NVRM/Xid entries since the synthetic failure; final SOL physiology was fully viable and conserved. Evidence now isolates the observed failure to the pathological sustained 8192x8192 FP16 stress class rather than ordinary SOL training, though low-level hardware/driver root cause remains unresolved.

title: Learn backward-credit routing from delayed branch reward
description: Replace instantaneous eligibility-alignment amplitude as the decision rule with a checkpointed, parameter-neutral three-factor branch memory. A branch-specific trace remembers relative decoder-credit/source-event alignment; later signed prequential reward reinforces or suppresses that remembered routing event; bounded fast routing preference allocates future reverse credit within each target fan. Preserve forward anatomy, ordinary BPTT, continuous stream state, dormant masks, and equal-fan transport scale.
acceptance_criteria: Default-disabled path and old checkpoints remain compatible; reward cannot change an untagged branch, a delayed positive/negative reward changes only remembered routing choices in opposite directions, preferences stay centered/bounded and dormant slots remain zero, routing state resumes exactly, parameter count is unchanged, and complete matched preflight curves are graphed before any full GPU promotion.
notes:
S19 gain1 was a 0.035% no-op. S20 gain100 produced 0.77-3.62% typical routing changes and different anatomy without capability: 8/15 wins, +0.00514 BPC regression, 0.57x effect/noise. Amplitude is falsified; next test must assign later fitness to remembered routing events.
Implemented default-disabled reward-plastic decoder-credit routing. FieldState adds target-owned routing eligibility/preference; delayed reward updates bounded competitive preference, which fan-in-normalizes future reverse credit. Alignment scale100 and preference gain1 were calibrated from final S20 checkpoints: one reward-addressed event changes routing 2.42%/1.46%/0.59% for seeds7/13/21 with zero saturation; gain3 begins saturation. Spawn/prune/graft/rollback/shuffle/checkpoint/UI telemetry handle the new branch state. Added causal sign/no-reward/equal-scale/dormant/parameter-count/delayed-loop/resume/compatibility tests. Verification: 91 repo tests pass, compileall/diff check clean; CPU CLI smoke and 200-update seed7 calibration are finite with nonzero unsaturated routing state.
Three-seed RTX 4090 preflight completed successfully at 1,000 updates with exact S17 protocol parity except the preregistered reward-plastic routing flags. Preference was active and nearly unsaturated: final persistent-eval mean |preference| 0.00777/0.00536/0.00237 for seeds 7/13/21; saturation <=0.00153%. Against S17, terminal updates 500/750/1000 yielded 8/9 treatment wins, pooled mean -0.000329 BPC and mean endpoint -0.000494 BPC. Effect/noise remains only 0.115 on the mean curve, so this is not capability evidence; it passes the active-and-not-adverse continuation gate. Graph: s21-preflight-gate.html. Exact checkpoints resumed to 2,000 updates in systemd units sol-s21-reward-routing-seed{7,13,21}-4090-resume on cuda:0 (4090).
Full 2,000-update S21 comparison completed successfully. Versus S17 over updates 1000-2000: seed7 mean -0.000497 BPC (4/5 wins, 0.037x noise, endpoint -0.003840); seed13 +0.000295 (2/5, 0.010x, endpoint +0.000967); seed21 +0.000600 (2/5, 0.038x, endpoint -0.002895). Pooled 8/15 wins; three-seed mean +0.000133 BPC regression, 0.014x effect/noise, endpoint -0.001922. All three regressed at 1750 (+0.003098 mean) before the favorable endpoint, demonstrating oscillation around zero. Final live routing deviations were material/bounded: 3.20%/1.25%/0.64% mean, 27.51%/19.86%/9.88% max, only seed7 1.39% live-slot saturation. Anatomy 36/31/31 edges with 18/12/5 spawns and 14/13/6 prunes, nearly identical to S17. S21 removes S20 harm but does not beat unrouted control. Reject promotion; graph s21-reward-routing-decision.html; 91 repo tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and tested delayed-reward branch routing through the full three-seed horizon. The policy learned material bounded routing changes but produced no detectable capability effect versus S17, so it remains default-disabled and is not promoted.

title: Test distributed predictive coding across the SOL field
description: Add an optional parameter-neutral auxiliary next-character objective at every SOL cell using the existing token embedding as a tied local readout. Keep designated output cells as the only emitted inference organ. The auxiliary signal must preserve continuous stream state, delayed reward, parameter count, checkpoint compatibility, and exact BPTT while giving sparse internal cells direct event-specific predictive error. Run a matched reduced-scale gain sweep before any full GPU claim.
notes: First tied-readout sweep (16x16, 800 updates, no metabolism/reward) is seed-sensitive and negative overall. Gain 0.03 final deltas vs matched control: seed7 -0.094 BPC (better), seed13 +0.090 worse, seed21 +0.142 worse; mean +0.046 worse. Gains 0.1 and 0.3 also hurt seed7. Diagnosis: auxiliary classifier gradients write directly into the same embedding used as sensory input, likely conflicting with the input codebook. Next test detaches the embedding only on the decoder side, preserving all-cell/axon backward credit while keeping sensory embedding learning on its ordinary input path.
close_reason: Falsified after matched three-seed sweeps. Fully tied all-cell prediction was capability-negative and seed-sensitive. Detached body-only prediction improved reward-disabled final BPC by 0.03593 mean, but with SOL delayed reward active its mean final benefit collapsed to 0.00153 BPC, mean best was 0.00809 worse, and two of three seeds regressed. Experimental code removed; results documented in S7.

Anatomy functional (final birth penalty +0.02565; late-six +0.03400) but organism worse. First-order sign is measurable telemetry, not a reliable acceptance criterion. Documented; no promotion.
close_reason: Implemented and tested organism-level gradient fitness. Zero-margin sign gating is non-selective at 64 targets and worsens capability versus both control and S3.

S17 now provides the adaptive matched control for a full reverse-credit GPU test: global-loss-gated variable fan-in, live exploratory traffic, output-error credit 0.5, and 2000-update horizon. Next treatment changes only backward_credit_gain from 0 to 0.25 across seeds 7/13/21 on the 4090; compare complete terminal curves and anatomy, not endpoints alone.
Full S18 matched GPU result: scalar reverse gain0.25 remained bounded/nonzero but failed capability. Per-seed terminal mean treatment-control BPC: seed7 -0.0083 (4/5 wins, 0.64x noise), seed13 -0.0030 (3/5, 0.13x), seed21 +0.0453 (1/5, 0.96x). Pooled 8/15 wins, +0.0113 BPC regression, endpoint +0.0019, effect/noise 0.65x. Active edges 35/33/29. Reject gain0.25; retain zero scalar gain. Graph: s18-reverse-credit-decision.html.

title: Add reversible post-graft probation for SOL axons
description: Keep the incumbent source recoverable after a confirmed graft. Let the entire continuously stimulated organism co-adapt for a bounded probation period under ordinary traffic, reward, and backprop; measure observed prequential fitness, then retain or roll back the anatomical change. Preserve optimizer/state integrity and use a matched living control. This directly tests body-with-organ developmental response instead of another pre-graft proxy.
design: Use one checkpointable active probation at a time. A confirmed candidate is installed provisionally while the incumbent source, edge parameters, optimizer moments, structural credit/age, and stream-local edge eligibility/fast efficacy are backed up exactly. The full organism then trains continuously for a bounded update budget while mean signed prequential reward is accumulated. At resolution, positive observed advantage commits the graft; otherwise every backed-up value is restored. New graft decisions pause during probation but exploratory probe traffic continues. Probes-only runs the same cadence as a virtual probation without topology mutation.
notes: Implemented exact reversible probation with checkpointed source/parameter/optimizer/credit/age/stream-local slot backup. Failed graft restores slot exactly while unrelated body learning and spent energy remain. Positive commits; probes-only virtual cadence. Active resume exact. Added pre-graft developmental reward EMA because raw reward committed ordinary learning; probation now scores improvement over the body's own trend. Full suite 47 passed. Natural 16x16 smoke (550 updates): growing 3 attempts, 0 commits, 3 rollbacks, no active trial, final topology exactly birth, 3.99063 BPC; virtual control 3 trials, 3.99328. Last improvement -0.00674 vs control -0.00624. Ready for full GPU.
close_reason: Implemented and deterministically validated exact reversible post-graft probation in commit 70c51ad; superseded as the primary experiment by within-organism exploratory traffic per user direction.

title: Randomize routing traffic and require randomization evidence
description: Replace S22 fixed ABBA phase with a checkpointed per-proposal crossover assignment: each four-window block independently uses ABBA or BAAB from a deterministic seed, retaining exact balance and zero linear-time covariance while decorrelating corpus windows across organisms. Store every reward observation and assignment, enumerate the exact block-randomization null at resolution, and commit routing preference only when positive advantage clears a preregistered one-sided randomization threshold. Keep morphology cadence, ordinary learning, and evaluation boundaries live and unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Default-disabled and old checkpoints remain exact; trial schedules are checkpointed, balanced, blockwise trend-neutral, and differ across topology seeds; individual rewards and exact randomization p-values are retained; null synthetic sequences reject while injected candidate effects commit; exact resume preserves schedule and verdict; natural-stream trial advantages are no longer phase-locked across seeds; anatomy remains S17 cadence-matched; graph the reduced matched run before longer GPU work.
notes: Implemented checkpointed ABBA/BAAB block assignments, exact null rank/p-value, arm-integrity checks, provisional block evidence, legacy active-S22 completion, CLI/telemetry, tests, and companion docs. Full local gate: 101 passed (4 pre-existing warnings). Corrected 400-update CPU living-body smoke: routing 5 trials (1 commit/4 reject; p=.03125,.96875,.875,.46875,.28125), structural traffic 7 trials (3 commit/4 reject), anatomy 8 mutations (3 spawn/5 prune), full cell/output reachability, no active trial at eval boundaries; held-out BPC 4.956@200 to 4.283@400, not a convergence claim. An earlier smoke omitted --structural-plasticity and is explicitly invalid/excluded. Next: commit/push, deploy, reduced matched 3-seed GPU run and graph.
close_reason: S23 complete: randomized crossover schedules eliminated routing phase-locking (8/31 unanimous signs vs S22 14/15; pair correlations -0.380/0.276/0.012), exact raw-reward inference and resume are verified, morphology remained live/reachable, and 2,000-update matched capability was neutral (mean endpoint -0.000332 BPC, effect/noise 0.034).
